stem: Which group was among the first to call for an end to slavery?

options.label: F
options.text: American Indians, because they viewed the plight of slaves as similar to their own

options.label: G
options.text: Quakers, because slavery contradicted their religious beliefs

options.label: H
options.text: British loyalists, because Great Britain had ended the slave trade

options.label: J
options.text: Puritans, because the New England economy did not rely on slavery
